data_description.visual_min_confidence: Minimum confidence (0.0–1.0) required before visual detections are accepted; higher values reduce false positives.
data_description.visual_confirm_seconds: The target must remain detected for this duration before an event is triggered. 0 triggers immediately.
data_description.class_stale_seconds: How long the detected state remains active after the target was last seen.
data_description.visual_cooldown_seconds: Minimum time before the same visual class can trigger another event.

data_description.audio_min_confidence: Minimum confidence (0.0–1.0) required before sound detections trigger an event.
data_description.audio_cooldown_seconds: Minimum time before the same sound class can trigger another event.

capture_device_snapshot.name: Take device snapshot
capture_device_snapshot.description: Capture one JPG directly to device /mnt storage. Independent of main/sub RTSP stream state; shares the device's single capture slot.

output.name: Output path
output.description: Must start with /mnt/ (directory or .jpg/.jpeg file). Leave empty to use the active device storage directory.

start_device_recording.name: Start device recording
start_device_recording.description: Record an MP4 clip directly to device /mnt storage. Independent of main/sub RTSP stream state; rejected if another capture is active.

output.name: Output path
output.description: Must start with /mnt/ (directory or .mp4 file). Leave empty to use the active device storage directory.

stop_device_capture.name: Stop device recording
stop_device_capture.description: Stop the active device recording started by this integration and wait until the file is finalized on /mnt storage.
